description: Get comprehensive customer status from caller ID in ONE call. Returns customer info, deposit status, travel rep status, booking status, and agent-ready message with recommended action.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Customer phone number from caller ID

usage_instructions.when_to_call: IMMEDIATELY at the start of every call, before greeting the customer
usage_instructions.how_to_use: Set phone parameter to {{call.from_number}} to automatically use caller ID
usage_instructions.silent_execution: Set speak_during_execution to false - this lookup is silent
usage_instructions.agent_message: Use {{agent_message}} variable to speak the recommended response to customer
usage_instructions.branching: Branch based on {{overall_status}} or {{deposit_status}} for different flows

overall_status_options: ready_to_schedule - Deposits complete, not yet booked
deposits_complete - Deposits complete, no travel date set
travel_rep_status_options: complete - TR assigned and docs sent
assigned_no_docs - TR assigned but no docs sent
needs_urgent - Travel date < 45 days, no TR
normal_window - Travel date 45-75 days, no TR
recommended_action_options: verify_itinerary - Customer is booked, ask if they need itinerary
transfer_to_scheduling - Deposits complete, transfer to schedule travel
offer_scheduling - Deposits complete, offer to schedule
collect_payment - Need to collect remaining payment

status.agent_message: Great news! Your deposits are complete and you're booked. Your travel rep is John Smith. Do you need your itinerary resent?
I see you've paid $250 toward your $750 deposit. You have $500 remaining. Would you like to complete your payment today?

customer_not_found.message: Customer not found in RIMS database

agent_flow_logic.greeting_personalization: Use {{agent_message}} to greet customer with personalized, contextual message
agent_flow_logic.deposit_complete_flow: If {{deposit_status}} == 'complete': Transfer to scheduling or verify itinerary
agent_flow_logic.deposit_incomplete_flow: If {{deposit_status}} == 'partial' or 'none': Provide payment information using {{deposit_remaining}} amount
agent_flow_logic.new_caller_flow: If {{customer_found}} == false: Standard greeting, ask how you can help
agent_flow_logic.ready_to_travel: If {{overall_status}} == 'ready_to_travel': Focus on itinerary and travel rep contact
